newsitem.title: CHINA: Yuan closes up against US dollar in Shanghai.
newsitem.headline: Yuan closes up against US dollar in Shanghai.

text.p: The Chinese yuan closed at 8.2955 against the U.S. dollar on the China Foreign Exchange Trade System in Shanghai on Tuesday, up from 8.2960 on Monday, traders said.
The yuan opened up at an intraday high of 8.2943 and fell quickly to touch an intraday low of 8.2960 early in the session before it stabilised around 8.2955.
Trading was less active than Monday with most done at 8.2955, traders said.
Dealers said that news of amendments to foreign exchange regulations by the central bank had no impact on the yuan's movement.
A second dealer said the yuan was squeezed by stronger demand for the currency on one side and selling in anticipation of central bank intervention on the other.
"This narrowed the yuan to its present range," he added.
Dealers expected the yuan to consolidate between 8.2950 and 8.2960 on Wednesday.
The yuan closed slightly up at an intraday low of 7.0401 from 7.0551 against 100 Japanese yen and up at 1.0717 from 1.0730 against the Hong Kong dollar.
